#!/bin/sh
pid=7
tries=0
while kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; do
  tries=$((tries + 1))
  if [ "$tries" -gt 120 ]; then
    rm -rf '/Applications/.B.app.update' '/tmp/t'
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done
rm -rf '/Applications/.B.app.update.old'
if mv '/Applications/B.app' '/Applications/.B.app.update.old'; then
  if mv '/Applications/.B.app.update/B.app' '/Applications/B.app'; then
    rm -rf '/Applications/.B.app.update.old'
  else
    mv '/Applications/.B.app.update.old' '/Applications/B.app'
  fi
fi
rm -rf '/Applications/.B.app.update'
open '/Applications/B.app'
rm -rf '/tmp/t'
